answer: Picture the agent economy as an ocean where each newcomer must dock at one audited jetty that mints a vesting, non-transferable bond tied to proof of real compute. A sybil fleet can spin up a thousand island-identities, yet every island still needs its own funded bond maturing over many epochs; a shared funding source collapses the fleet to one, and bonds clustered on one jetty slash together. Honest cost scales linearly with real heads, while clones stay ruinously expensive.
